hero.title: Know the moment something changes.
hero.body: YourApp checks the pages, feeds and endpoints you care about on a schedule, and tells you exactly what changed. No dashboard to babysit.

graphic.label: A lens moving over a pile of shapes that stand for watched pages, magnifying each one as it checks it

demo.title: Monitoring
demo.added: Watching: first check in a minute

how.title: Set it up once. Hear about it only when it matters.
how.body: Add what you want watched and pick how often. Everything else happens on its own: checks run, changes are compared, and you get one clear message.

list.title: One list, always current
list.desc: Everything you watch, when it was last checked, and what changed, in one place.

add.title: Add anything with a URL
add.desc: Paste a page, a feed or an API endpoint. Give it a label and a note so future you remembers why.

schedule.title: Checked on your schedule
schedule.desc: Daily on the free plan, hourly on paid plans. Every check is kept, so you can see when a change happened.

alerts.title: Alerts that show the change
alerts.desc: Not just "something changed": the email shows the lines that are different, before and after.

digest.title: A weekly digest
digest.desc: One summary every Monday: what changed, what stayed the same, and what could not be reached.

items.d: Group items and keep the context next to them.
Every check and every change, with the time it happened.
No alert unless something actually changed.
The app and its emails follow your language setting.
Downgrade or cancel from your account, no emails needed.
Pay monthly or as you go, with refunds on unused credit.

pricing.title: Start free. Pay when you need more.
pricing.subtitle: Every plan has the same features; paid plans watch more items, more often.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. The free plan needs only an email address. You add a card when you choose a paid plan.
One URL you want watched: a page, a feed or an API endpoint. Your plan sets how many you can have.
From Plans in your account. Paid features stay on until the end of the period you paid for.
In our AWS account in the United States. We never sell it or share it for advertising.
